# HumFut: Sounds for Calls

> HumFut is a free-to-try iPhone app that plays sounds, reactions and background music into a call you're already on, so the other person hears them live, mixed in with your voice, on Phone, FaceTime, WhatsApp, Zoom and other calls.

Tap a sound and the person on the other end hears it: a laugh, applause, a "one moment" chime, your own clips, background music, or a typed message that HumFut speaks. Sounds can be shared with friends as small .humfut files. HumFut never uses the microphone and never records a call. It needs iOS 26 or later. The first 3 calls with Call Sounds on are free; one single purchase unlocks it for every call.

- [Where to find sounds](https://humfut.nullbytes.app/sounds.html): how to share a sound in from a website
- [Support](https://humfut.nullbytes.app/support.html): setup, music and levels, sharing, backup, fixes
- [Privacy Policy](https://humfut.nullbytes.app/privacy.html)
